Fortress


Setting

The fortress is Zak’s first encounter with Suslanger’s coercive order. Kardaur controls his captivity, while the enslaved Odalisque offers a chance of escape. The conversation reveals both the authority of the fortress and resentment within its walls. [1, 2, 3]

Captivity in Death Canyon

Zak is captured near the portal on Suslanger. Lieutenant Kardaur presents him to Aiset-Bek, who orders him used as live quarry for soldiers seeking promotion. Surviving the run through Death Canyon earns only a return to captivity, not freedom. Kardaur threatens punishment through necromancy if Zak dies too quickly and displeases his superior. [4, 5]

The Odalisque and the escape

The Odalisque approaches Zak after his ordeal. Enslaved by Kardaur and deprived even of a personal name, she wants his death and knows he will guard the gate that night. She steals the key to Zak’s cage. Her father, a rat hunter who disappeared in the caves, told her of the Wormheads’ temple and the bridges across its lava rivers. She uses that knowledge to explain a route the guards fear to follow. Zak kills Kardaur for the fortress key and escapes toward the cave; releasing the caged spiders can delay pursuit. The Odalisque and Zak part with wishes for each other’s freedom and survival, without a stated account of her later fate. [2, 3, 6, 7, 8]
